description: Land Acquisition - Thalwatta, Boowelikada and Watapuluwa, Kandy D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of 18 specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, plot numbers, extents, and locations. The content is exclusively focused on land matters (acquisition and property descriptions) without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
